name: scut-schedule
description: Save sourced academic schedules, apply updates, and present weekly plans, conflicts, free slots and briefings from the user's WorkBuddy library.

displayDescription.en: Import timetables, save assignments and notices, and view sourced weekly plans, conflicts, free slots and briefings.
displayDescription.zh: 面向华工大学城校区，整理课表、作业、消息与通知，查看周计划、冲突、空档和简报，保留来源与更正历史。
